# ELITE DENTAL

Stores the future neutral partner, licence or franchise model: partner criteria, operating standards, training, quality control, economics, territory, brand use, audit rights and exit rules.

Current state: `PRIVATE / CONCEPT_AND_READINESS_ONLY`.

ELITE DENTAL must not be sold on the RAIMOV DENTAL patient site. No franchise fee, profitability, payback, territory, exclusivity or partner claim may publish before repeatable clinic economics, legal structure, training and quality-control evidence exist.
